status.note: The runtime and six windows ship and run: the OKR review in com.etendoerp.uikit.samples and five demos in com.etendoerp.uikit.demos. L5 facts, L6 source gates and L7 window gates are real; L7 is a runner over the per-window manifests. L2-dts is generated from the runtime JSDoc. Recipes and the per-symbol reference land later, harvested from the samples rather than written ahead of them; entries marked planned are not written yet and must not exist.

invariants: never edit core: src/, src-core/, src-wad/, modules_core/
never touch the SmartClient handle after draw: no setStyleName, no getHandle().innerHTML
never add a listener on document or window; use the view's on: map
every visible string goes through t('KEY') and needs an AD_MESSAGE row in your module
CSS uses --uik-* only; no --sk-* outside the token block, no .etskin-* selector
one IIFE per file, no top-level bindings
ES2018 is allowed and correct; do not downgrade modern syntax to ES5 (fact F1)
parsing is not working: load the page before declaring a window done

gates.what: the kernel's own JSMin accepts ES2018 and the harness rejects a real syntax error
every web file shipped by any com.etendoerp.uikit* module survives JSMin + node --check; zero shipped files is a failure, not a skip -- a framework that ships no JavaScript is broken
every web file shipped by any com.etendoerp.uikit* module is a single IIFE with no top-level bindings
AGENTS.md is within budget and states the workflow and the invariants
this index resolves: present docs exist, planned docs do not, budgets respected
every code block in the docs minifies and parses; every OB.UIKit symbol named in the docs is indexed
every file:line citation in L5 still points at the text it claims
no core file is modified in the working tree
documentation and implementation agree: no doc on disk is unregistered, nothing the runtime ships is undocumented, and no symbol is marked planned while it ships
docs/api/uikit.d.ts still matches the JSDoc it is generated from
